# splunkctl api

Call Splunk REST endpoints.

## api delete

Preview a REST DELETE; --yes executes.

> Guarded mutation: dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl api delete [OPTIONS] PATH
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--param` | text | - | Add a request parameter. |

## api get

Read a REST endpoint.

```text
splunkctl api get [OPTIONS] PATH
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--param` | text | - | Add a request parameter. |
| `--describe` | flag | - | List required, optional and wildcard fields from PATH/_new. |

## api post

Preview a REST POST; --yes executes.

> Guarded mutation: dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl api post [OPTIONS] PATH
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--param` | text | - | Add a request parameter. |
| `--body` | text | - | Send a raw request body. |
| `--body-file` | file | - | Read the request body from a file. |
| `--content-type` | text | - | Set the request content type. |
